objective: Replace label-defined rescue with exact executable intervention semantics for normalized P1 trajectories whose dependency and repair semantics are explicit.

breakthrough.causal_criterion: A repair set receives causal credit iff applying that set and recomputing the declared dependency graph changes every declared terminal failed resource from unavailable to available.
breakthrough.minimality: Report inclusion-minimal rescuing repair sets; unique singleton is IDENTIFIED, unique multi-repair set is INTERACTION, multiple distinct minimal rescuers are AMBIGUOUS.
breakthrough.false_earliest_violation_counterexample: An early SCOPE violation on one branch of an ALTERNATIVE dependency is noncausal when another healthy branch suffices and a later STATE_TRANSITION defect blocks terminal success. V5 selects the early ancestor; V6 selects the later executable cause.
